name: SBD series assistance and rescue droid
wookieepedia_title: SBD series assistance and rescue droid
description: The SBD series assistance and rescue droid, or SBD, was a model of droid manufactured by Karflo Corporation. The SBD series was designed to accompany surveyors and explorers in areas far from civilization or dangerous environments. The droids had a rugged and durable design, and were programmed with intellect and a desire to assist.
